source: Math grade 3, chapter 1, lesson «شمارش چندتا چندتا» (book p. 10). Card v1.0 (source docx L1689: 12 fruits into 4 equal baskets, Drag & Group + snap, GROUP-M01/M02, H1–H3) + card v1.1 (L2770: groups of 2, 5, 10, Number Trail, tap to count a group, counting one by one allowed but slower + comparative observation). Plan 12 §1 row 2: Number Trail steps 2/5/10 on the plaza paving → 12 fruits into 4 baskets at the festival stall; world state VIL_STALL_READY; Transfer later in the mill (Q04, outside the VS).

stages.objective_fa: سیب‌ها را روی میز بگذار تا تیکو درست روی سنگِ طلایی بایستد.

hints.animation: glow_one_full_basket + dotted arc of one step on the trail
step numbers appear on the ground stones

stages.objective_fa: ۱۲ سیب را در ۴ سبد بچین؛ همهٔ سبدها باید برابر باشند.

hints.animation: one basket with 3 apples highlighted as the example
3 ghost slots in every basket show its share

misconceptions.description: Reaches the total only by adding single apples: treats skip counting as ‘just faster counting’ and does not use the equal groups (card v1.1).
Adds one more group after the target (does not stop at the target while stepping). Team addition (not in the source cards): logged for the parent report, never shown as an error message.
Puts all fruit in some baskets and leaves others empty: counts the total without forming groups (card v1.0).
Every basket has fruit but the groups are not equal, e.g. 4 3 3 2 (card v1.0).

mastery.note: card v1.1 mastery: equal steps with two different group types (steps 2/5/10 + baskets of 3) + Transfer. Levels 4-5 need the Transfer (mill sacks in groups of 3, Q04; workshop screws in equal boxes) — outside the VS, plan 06 §9

audio.on_place: fruit soft thump / basket wooden click
audio.on_wrong: soft wobble, no punishment, no layer
